changelog: feat: the beta chart editor now has every tab the production one has, grouped the same way — Taxonomy (six ranks plus three taxonomic heatmaps), Alpha (Shannon, Observed, Chao1, Simpson, Faith's PD, Shannon rarefaction, all metrics as small multiples), Beta (PCoA, PCA scree, NMDS Bray and Jaccard, Bray and Jaccard heatmaps, UPGMA Bray and Jaccard) and Other (read counts, read tracking, rarefaction, species accumulation, rank abundance, ASV lengths, OTU distribution). The tab list is ported from ALL_TABS verbatim, and a tab appears only when the file behind it is in THIS job's result folder, so the row shows what the run produced rather than what the app can draw in principle. The heatmaps get the production colour-scale picker, all eight scales. Everything is still one settings file: {font, colors, sampleAliases, sampleOrder} in edit_charts/settings.json, colorscale included, so either console opens the other's work. UPGMA is computed here from the distance matrix with average linkage — the same method the pipeline uses — rather than shown as a picture, so it reorders and recolours like everything else. Fixes the rank picker offering 'Table': taxonomy_table.csv matched the pattern it used, so the ASV table was offered as if it were a taxonomic rank. Tabs name their files explicitly, so that class of mistake cannot recur. Fixes a worse one found while testing: switching tabs applied the NEW tab's chart kind to the OLD tab's data, because the shape was not cleared until the next file arrived. It threw on one combination, which is how it was caught; on others it would have drawn the previous tab's numbers under this tab's title for a moment. A chart that is briefly wrong is a chart someone screenshots. RdYlGn is kept because the production console offers it, and labelled: it is red-to-green and the one scale in the list that does not survive colour-blind simulation. Viridis is the default and says the same thing. Taxa past the eighth still fold into one grey Other, and unassigned reads still never take a colour slot.
